name: Camuzzi Gas Pampeana S.A.
summary: Camuzzi Gas Pampeana S.A. distributes natural gas in Argentina. It serves approximately 2 million families, businesses, and manufacturing plants through approximately 50,000 kilometer of gas transport pipeline and distribution network systems in the Buenos Aires, La Pampa, Neuquén, Chubut, Río Negro, Santa Cruz, and Tierra del Fuego provinces. The company is based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
